bossPhases.description: Ymir feeds on the void (Phase I)
bossPhases.quip: You bleed me — and I drink from the void to refill the wound.
Enough! The first scream of creation answers ME.

bossRules.description: Ymir spawns frost-giant offspring at start

bossPhases.description: Bergelmir hardens with the cold of his grief
bossPhases.quip: Bergelmir’s spear hardens with the rime of his oath — the cold loves the wronged.
Hear me, Ymir-father. Today I bring you sons.

bossRules.description: Bergelmir has 115 health — survivor of the blood-flood

bossPhases.quip: Hear me, brothers below! The walls are not yet sealed!

bossRules.description: Giant war-lord starts with +1 mana crystal

bossPhases.description: A blinding pulse from the corrupted shard
bossPhases.quip: I show you what we showed Freyr. Look at the LIGHT.

bossPhases.description: Yggdrasil’s roots feed the dark elf
bossPhases.quip: The roots remember all the names that ever fell into them.

bossRules.description: Dark-elf lord draws an extra card each turn

bossPhases.description: The Vanir draw on the green earth
bossPhases.quip: Yggdrasil drinks. So do I.
Idunn’s apples are not given to gods who burn their guests.

bossRules.description: Vanir war-leader starts with +1 mana crystal

bossPhases.quip: I have been carrying this storm for an age. NOW it walks.
Hear me, Ymir-grandfather. The blood-flood walks again.
My wife survived with me on that log. She lived just long enough to bear our sons. Then she went into the cold. THEY are the price you should be paying.

bossRules.description: Bergelmir has 120 health — ancient and terrible
Bergelmir's hatred deals 1 damage to your hero each turn

bossPhases.quip: Huginn. Muninn. Watch closely. We will need to remember this one.
Even Hlidskjalf has its limits. I draw on the seed of Yggdrasil.
Then I will see you in Valhalla. SKOLL — TAKE THE SUN!

bossRules.description: The forces of Ragnarok have 120 health
The twilight draws an extra omen each turn

bossPhases.quip: GUNNLOD! BAR THE INNER DOOR!

bossPhases.description: Thiazi draws on his ancient years
bossPhases.quip: I am older than the mountain you stand on. I do not need to tire.
If I cannot have her, no one can taste an apple ever again.

bossRules.description: Eagle’s eye — Thiazi draws an extra card each turn

bossPhases.quip: The deep loves what is left in it.

bossPhases.description: The serpent’s breath turns the air to poison
bossPhases.quip: I am the venom that ends you. I am ALWAYS the venom that ends you.

bossRules.description: Jormungandr has 130 health — it circles the world
The deep gives the serpent endless venom

bossPhases.description: Fenrir tests his strength against Gleipnir
bossPhases.quip: Show me the rest of you. Show me ALL of you.
TYR! Where is your hand!

bossRules.description: Fenrir has 125 health — the cosmos cannot hold him

bossPhases.quip: Hod, hold out your hand. I have a present for you.
I always wondered which of these gods was Frigg’s favorite. Now we will know.
Throw, brother. Throw straight. Let me guide your hand.

bossRules.description: Loki cannot quite die yet — the story still needs him
Loki always has one more trick than you do

bossPhases.quip: I have worn so many faces. I have a few left.
You are very brave for a creature whose god I just killed.

bossRules.description: Thokk has many faces and only one of them is hers
Loki has read this scene before

bossPhases.description: Loki shifts shape to slip the chains
bossPhases.quip: A salmon was the wrong choice. I should have been a hawk.
You think this is what I deserve. You think THIS is the worst the cosmos can do to me.
My WIFE will be sitting in the dark with a bowl for an AGE because of you. Are you proud?

bossRules.description: The cosmos cannot quite kill its trickster
Loki has had ages to plan this

bossPhases.quip: SKOLL! Now! While the goddess is tired!
HATI! Bring down the moon!

bossPhases.description: The dark closes in on all sides
bossPhases.quip: There is no light left to fear me by.

bossRules.description: The wolves of the sky have been hungry an entire age
The cold is on every side
Fimbulvetr drains 1 HP from your hero each turn

bossPhases.description: Thor and Jormungandr kill each other
bossPhases.quip: THOR! BROTHER! Step into the serpent’s breath! The cosmos has been waiting!

bossPhases.description: Tyr and Garm finish each other
bossPhases.quip: TYR! GARM! Old enemies. Long contract. END IT.
ODIN. Look at me, brother. Look UP. Look at the WOLF.

bossPhases.description: Surtr the fire-giant raises his sword
bossPhases.quip: And then, of course — SURTR, brother, do you have a moment?

bossRules.description: The end of the world has 140 HP and three of its own armies
Surtr brings the fires of Muspelheim
Prophecy gives the enemy an extra card
The world is ending. 2 damage every turn.

bossPhases.description: Uranus presses down with the weight of stars
bossPhases.quip: I press down. The Earth itself cannot lift me.
GAIA! Hold him still! He is YOUR son!

bossRules.description: Uranus's crushing sky deals 1 damage each turn

bossPhases.quip: I have already swallowed everything that could threaten me. Now I will swallow you.
My BELLY! Something is moving in my BELLY!

bossRules.description: Cronus has 105 health from Titan constitution

bossPhases.quip: My coils are older than the chains the Cyclopes wear.

bossRules.description: Campe starts with a guardian serpent on the battlefield

bossPhases.description: Atlas calls in the giant volley
bossPhases.quip: HUNDRED-HANDERS! THROW! Three hundred boulders apiece!
I am the wall the Olympians cannot get past.

bossRules.description: Atlas has 110 health — mightiest of the Titan warriors
Atlas rallies Titan reinforcements each turn

bossPhases.description: Zeus draws on the wrath of Olympus
bossPhases.quip: My OWN cousin. Stealing from MY hearth.

bossPhases.description: Typhon’s hundred heads roar at once
bossPhases.quip: Ten more heads grow when one is cut. Ten more flames rise from each black eye.
I will burn HERA. I will burn ARTEMIS. I will burn the SKY.

bossRules.description: Typhon has 115 health — mightiest monster ever born
Typhon's hundred dragon-heads deal 2 damage each turn

bossPhases.quip: Throw the FLAMING OAKS! Throw the MOUNTAINS!

bossPhases.description: Porphyrion calls on the prophecy that protects him
bossPhases.quip: I am the KING of giants. I cannot fall to a god alone.

bossRules.description: Porphyrion has 110 health — king of the Giants
The giant horde provides endless reinforcements

bossPhases.quip: I am the strategy AND the wisdom. You will need to outthink BOTH.
I open the rifts of Tartarus. The Titans stir in their chains.
Chaos itself comes back through me. I birthed it. It always comes home.
Zeus will fall. As Cronus did. As Uranus did. The cycle DOES not stop. It only PAUSES.

bossRules.description: Gaia's Remnant has 120 health — primordial endurance

bossPhases.quip: My tail drips poison faster than your heart can race.

bossPhases.description: Ma’at calls on the laws of the cosmos
bossPhases.quip: The forty-two negative confessions. Recite them. NOW.

bossRules.description: Ma'at draws wisdom from the scales

bossPhases.description: Ammit lunges with all three jaws
bossPhases.quip: I have eaten more pharaohs than you can name. Add yourself to the list.
My SANDSTORM scoured kingdoms off the map.

bossPhases.description: Set draws on his oldest crime
bossPhases.quip: My BROTHER’S BLOOD is on every grain of sand.

bossPhases.description: Ra blinds you with the eye of the sun
bossPhases.quip: My EYE is the sun itself. Look at it. LOOK.
I have sailed twelve hours through serpents. THIS is hour ONE.

bossPhases.description: Isis weaves a spell of restoration
bossPhases.quip: I tricked Ra into giving me his TRUE name. There is no spell I cannot speak.

bossRules.description: Isis weaves extra cards from magic

bossPhases.description: Anubis calls the four sons of Horus
bossPhases.quip: I open the canopic jars. The four sons of Horus are watching you.
No god has ever escaped my chamber by being clever. Be unclever, then. Try strength.
My coils stretch from the start of time to the end of it.
The sun. Mine. ALWAYS mine.

bossRules.description: Apophis' darkness deals 2 damage each turn

bossPhases.description: Osiris reads from the Book of the Dead
bossPhases.quip: I open the Book of the Dead. Every spell I needed to come back is in here.
My WIFE put me back together. My SON avenged me. I am the LEAST alone god in this hall.
I have an eternity. You have a heartbeat. Use it carefully.

bossRules.description: Osiris draws from the Book of the Dead

bossPhases.description: The druid draws on the forest's life force
bossPhases.quip: The roots remember EVERY footstep. The forest is not finished with you.
Maiden. Mother. Crone. THREE Morrigans, ONE quarry.

bossPhases.description: Cu Chulainn enters his warp spasm
bossPhases.quip: My eye sinks. My muscles re-arrange. The WARP SPASM is on me.

bossRules.description: Cu Chulainn's warp spasm grants extra vitality

bossPhases.description: The Salmon reads your future moves
bossPhases.quip: I know what you will do BEFORE you do it.

bossRules.description: The Salmon grants extra wisdom (bonus draw)

bossPhases.quip: OPEN. THE. EYE.

bossRules.description: Balor's Evil Eye deals 1 damage each turn

bossPhases.description: The Dagda taps the resurrection end of his club
bossPhases.quip: My club has TWO ENDS, friend. The OTHER one heals me.

bossPhases.description: Tir na nOg restores its guardians
bossPhases.quip: Look at the FIELDS. Look at the LIGHT. Why would you want to leave?

bossRules.description: Tir na nOg's guardians have 110 health

bossPhases.quip: HOUNDS! Tighten the circle! Drive them to me!
I am the SMITH. The hammer falls.
I am the HEALER. I undo the work of the smith.
I am the WARRIOR. Areadbhar is hungry.

bossPhases.description: Lugh the smith hardens his armor
bossPhases.quip: I am the SMITH. I have forged a thousand things you will never see.

bossPhases.description: Lugh the sorcerer unfolds his last art
bossPhases.quip: I am the SORCERER. I have read every page of every book ever written in the Otherworld.

bossRules.description: Lugh draws from mastery of all crafts

bossPhases.description: Amaterasu floods the field with light
bossPhases.quip: I am the SUN. There is no shadow you can stand in here.

bossPhases.description: The Jade Emperor calls in the entire celestial court
bossPhases.quip: CELESTIAL bureaucracy will deal with you in EVERY universe.
TYPHOON. Now. ALL of it.
I HAVE seventy-two FORMS. I am about to use forty of them.
My grief HARDENS me. Look at it. LOOK at what death made of me.

bossRules.description: Yomi's decay deals 2 damage each turn

bossPhases.description: Ganesha solves the puzzle in his head while you fight
bossPhases.quip: I have FOUR hands and one of them is holding the puzzle.

bossPhases.description: The poison Halahala rises from the churning
bossPhases.quip: POISON rises before the elixir. Drink it, Shiva! Save us!

bossPhases.description: The Amrita rises from the cosmic ocean
bossPhases.quip: AMRITA. The nectar. NOW.
My garland of skulls grows by one head each step. KEEP COUNT.
I am TIME. Time always wins.

bossRules.description: Kali's dance deals 2 damage each turn

bossPhases.quip: I am NORSE Ragnarok. The wolf. The serpent. The fire-giant. ALL of it.
I am GREEK Gigantomachy. The Giants. Typhon. Gaia’s tired final breath.
I am EGYPTIAN apocalypse. The Sun barge swallowed by Apophis. The dawn that does not come.
I am CELTIC ending. The Otherworld closes its mists for the last time. The Tuatha go into the mounds and never come out.
And I am EASTERN finality. Kali’s last dance. The dragon swallows its tail. THE COSMOS BREATHES OUT.

bossRules.description: The unraveling deals 2 damage each turn
